# Substratec

> > Substratec: Technical resource for adhesive bonding technologies, dispensing systems, and polymer material specifications for industrial applications.

Substratec provides comprehensive information on adhesive bonding solutions, including structural adhesives from manufacturers like Sika, precision dispensing equipment from Graco, and detailed technical glossaries covering thermoplastics (PA, PBT, PC, PEEK, PMMA, PPS) and adhesive technologies. The site serves as a reference for engineers and professionals working with polymer materials and bonding applications.

## Key Topics

- Adhesive bonding technology
- Thermoplastics (PA, PA 6, PA 6.6, PA 12, PBT, PC, PEEK, PMMA, PPS, PET, PES, PSU)
- Structural adhesives
- Polyurethane adhesives
- 2-component adhesive systems
- Solvent adhesives
- Composite bonding (CFRP)
- Dispensing and metering systems
- Room-temperature curing adhesives
- Polymer material properties
- Graco precision dispensing
- Sika SikaForce products
- Adhesive processing technology

## Adhesive Bonding Technologies

- [SikaForce®-840 L07 ~ Adhesive Bonding Technology](https://substratec.com/en/i/adhesive-bonding-technologies/sika-sikaforce-840-l07-polyurethane-structural-adhesive): Sika 2-component polyurethane structural adhesive for CFRP bonding

## Dispensing & Processing Technology

- [Precision Continuous Flow Metering & Dispensing Systems (PCF) ~ Dosing and Processing Technology](https://substratec.com/en/i/dispensing-processing-technology/graco-distribution-precision-continuous-flow-metering-dispensing-systems-pcf): Graco PCF automated metering system for adhesives and sealants

## Adhesive Glossary & Reference

- [Thermoplastics](https://substratec.com/en/adhesive-glossary/thermoplastics): Glossary entry defining thermoplastics (PA, PA 6) for adhesive bonding
- [Solvent Adhesive](https://substratec.com/en/adhesive-glossary/solvent-adhesive): Glossary entry explaining solvent adhesive technology and applications
